title: processkit derived item status
description: Derived facts processkit reports as the status member of an item in single-item results (show, get, explain). Authored content never contains status.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics for this item; each has the diagnostic shape of cli@v1.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the source file that holds the item's envelope.

path.description: POSIX path of that file, relative to the root of the repository that holds it.

provenance.description: Provenance of the item; members are defined by inheritance@v1.

references.description: Every typed reference in the item's spec, in document order.

pointer.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901) of the reference within the item.

origin.description: Present when the target is inherited: the target's provenance (inheritance@v1), which carries the upstream identity.
